'''Holowan Laboratories''', the so-called "Friendly Technology People" located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Halowan]], were the designers and manufacturers of the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] line of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]], responsible for the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]], was a subsidiary of this company. This was where [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]] first escaped, [[Holowan Massacre|slaughtered]] his creators, and programmed [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]], [[IG-88C/Legends|IG-88C]], and [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D]]. He also met [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]].
